title: Bittersweet Love Stories
intro: Love is sweetest when it costs something. These are the stories that linger long after the credits.

films.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
films.line: Would you erase the pain if it meant losing every beautiful moment too.

films.title: In the Mood for Love
films.line: Two neighbours fall into a love so quiet it could shatter you completely.

films.title: Blue Valentine
films.line: A romance told in two timelines, tender and brutal in equal measure.

films.title: Atonement
films.line: A single lie bends two lives across decades of longing and regret.

films.title: Certified Copy
films.line: A couple whose history keeps shifting beneath you like sand under water.

films.title: Never Let Me Go
films.line: Three friends carry a love story weighted by a fate they cannot outrun.

films.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
films.line: Every stolen glance carries the weight of a love that was never meant to last.

films.title: Closer
films.line: Four people tangle in desire and honesty cuts deeper than any betrayal.
